about: Shots for docs/user/img/, taken by tools/doc_screenshots.py. Each shot opens a fresh page on its show at `mode` (build, apply or watch), runs its steps in order, then screenshots `target` (a CSS selector) or, without one, the viewport. Steps: {"click": sel}, {"check": sel}, {"fill": [sel, text]}, {"select": [sel, value]}, {"wait": ms}, {"wait_for": sel}, {"css": rules}, {"console": "demo" | "address"}. `watch: true` lets the shot start a watch, which only the Demo rig may; `preview: true` lets a Demo shot run an unconfirmed Apply or Patch preview against the Demo's simulated WING.
